changelog: Valenixia POS v3.2.2 — Install button now downloads real native APK/EXE instead of lightweight PWA cache.
changes: Install banner now redirects to full native APK (~16 MB) on Android or Windows EXE on desktop
Platform-aware banner icon and description (Android robot icon vs desktop monitor icon)
Browser PWA install (1.55 MB cache) is fully suppressed — users always get the hardware-capable native build
